messages.text:
"RANK UP: THE AWAKENING

Complete Mobile Idle RPG Game

Create an original 3D dark fantasy idle RPG for Android mobile devices.

The game must have realistic 3D graphics, third-person camera and autonomous character combat.

The player controls the character's development, equipment, skills, class and dungeon progression, while the character fights automatically.

IMPORTANT: Build a functional playable game, not just a visual concept or menu mockup.

1. GAME CONCEPT

The player starts as a weak Rank F hunter in a dangerous fantasy world.

The objective is to become one of the strongest hunters by defeating monsters, completing dungeons, collecting equipment, learning abilities and evolving through ranks.

The game is single-player.

2. GRAPHICS AND CAMERA

- Realistic 3D dark fantasy graphics.
- Detailed character models and monsters.
- Third-person camera following the player.
- Cinematic lighting and shadows.
- Dark medieval fantasy environments.
- Smooth animations.
- Optimized for Android mobile devices.

3. IDLE COMBAT SYSTEM

The character must fight automatically.

- Automatically detect nearby enemies.
- Automatically move towards enemies.
- Automatically perform basic attacks.
- Automatically select the next enemy.
- Enemies attack the player.
- Player and enemies have health bars.
- Character can die and respawn.
- Boss encounters with larger health bars.

The player manually activates special abilities using touchscreen buttons.

4. MANUAL SKILLS

Create four skill buttons:

1. Powerful Strike.
2. Area Attack.
3. Healing.
4. Ultimate Ability.

Each skill must have:

- Unique visual effect.
- Damage or healing values.
- Cooldown timer.
- Functional touchscreen interaction.

5. CHARACTER PROGRESSION

Create a complete RPG progression system.

Character attributes:

- Strength.
- Agility.
- Vitality.
- Intelligence.

Include:

- Character level.
- Experience points.
- Gold.
- Attribute points.
- Health.
- Attack damage.
- Defense.
- Critical chance.
- Critical damage.

Enemies grant experience and gold when defeated.

6. RANK SYSTEM

Create nine character ranks:

F, E, D, C, B, A, S, SS, SSS.

The player starts at Rank F.

Higher ranks require specific levels, achievements and progression milestones.

Each rank must have:

- Unique visual design.
- Rank emblem.
- Progression requirements.
- Unlockable rewards.

Rank and character class must be separate systems.

7. CLASS SYSTEM

Create four character classes:

WARRIOR:

- Knight.
- Paladin.
- Warrior King.

ASSASSIN:

- Shadow.
- Reaper.
- Shadow Lord.

MAGE:

- Sorcerer.
- Archmage.
- Arcane Master.

NECROMANCER:

- Summoner.
- Master of the Dead.
- Undead Sovereign.

The player starts as an unclassified hunter.

Unlock classes through special quests.

Each class has different attributes, weapons, combat styles and abilities.

Allow switching between unlocked classes.

8. DUNGEON SYSTEM

Create a dungeon progression system.

Initial dungeons:

- Forgotten Catacombs.
- Abandoned Mines.
- Dark Abyss.

Each dungeon has multiple enemy encounters and a final boss.

Defeating the boss unlocks the next dungeon.

Add increasing difficulty and rewards.

For the first playable version, implement only the Forgotten Catacombs.

9. ENEMIES AND BOSSES

Initial enemy types:

- Skeleton Warrior.
- Goblin.
- Dark Creature.

Initial boss:

- Skeleton King.

Each enemy must have:

- Health.
- Attack damage.
- Defense.
- Experience reward.
- Gold reward.
- Chance to drop equipment.

10. EQUIPMENT AND INVENTORY

Create equipment slots:

- Weapon.
- Helmet.
- Chest armor.
- Gloves.
- Boots.
- Necklace.
- Ring.

Create seven equipment rarities:

- Common: White.
- Uncommon: Green.
- Rare: Blue.
- Epic: Purple.
- Legendary: Orange.
- Mythic: Red.
- Divine: Gold.

Equipment must affect character statistics.

Include inventory, equipment comparison and upgrade functionality.

11. OFFLINE PROGRESSION

Implement offline progression.

When the player exits the game:

- Save the current game state.
- Record the logout timestamp.

When the player returns:

- Calculate elapsed time.
- Simulate offline combat rewards.
- Award experience and gold.
- Calculate possible equipment rewards.
- Display an offline rewards summary.

Maximum offline reward duration: 8 hours.

12. GAME INTERFACE

Create a modern dark fantasy mobile interface.

Main screens:

- Main character screen.
- Character statistics.
- Equipment.
- Inventory.
- Skills.
- Class selection.
- Rank progression.
- Dungeon selection.
- Offline rewards.

Main combat interface must display:

- Character health.
- Enemy health.
- Experience bar.
- Character level.
- Current rank.
- Gold.
- Four manual skill buttons.

Use large touchscreen-friendly buttons.

13. SAVE SYSTEM

Implement persistent game saving.

Save:

- Character level.
- Experience.
- Gold.
- Rank.
- Class and class progression.
- Attributes.
- Equipment.
- Inventory.
- Dungeon progress.
- Skill upgrades.
- Offline timestamp.

The player's progress must remain saved after closing and reopening the application.

14. FIRST PLAYABLE VERSION

Do not attempt to implement the entire game at once.

Build the first functional version with:

- One playable 3D character.
- Third-person camera.
- Automatic combat.
- Four manual skill buttons.
- One dungeon: Forgotten Catacombs.
- Three enemy types.
- One boss: Skeleton King.
- Experience and gold.
- Basic equipment drops.
- Rank F progression.
- Persistent save system.
- Basic offline rewards.

Create the remaining systems with an expandable structure for future development.

FINAL REQUIREMENTS

Prioritize functional gameplay over visual decoration.

Do not create an open world.

Do not require manual joystick movement.

Do not create multiplayer.

Do not remove existing functionality when adding future systems.

Make the game playable on Android mobile devices with optimized performance.

The result must be a real playable idle RPG prototype.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a functional, playable dark fantasy idle RPG prototype, “RANK UP: THE AWAKENING,” for mobile devices.
- Deliver the first playable version with autonomous 3D combat, skills, a dungeon boss, progression, loot, saving, and offline rewards.

## Requirements
- Third-person 3D dungeon combat; automatic movement/targeting/attacks, enemy attacks, health bars, death and respawn.
- Four touchscreen skills with effects and cooldowns; XP, gold, attributes, stats, and Rank F progression.
- Forgotten Catacombs with Skeleton Warrior, Goblin, Dark Creature, and Skeleton King.
- Equipment slots and rarity-based drops; equipment affects stats.
- Persistent saves and offline rewards capped at eight hours, with a rewards summary.
- Expandable class/rank/dungeon structure; no open world, multiplayer, or manual joystick.
- Build a playable game now; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- The repository contained no game implementation, so the assistant chose a self-contained browser game using Three.js from a CDN, procedural 3D visuals, and `localStorage`.
- Initial scope implements Forgotten Catacombs; additional classes, ranks, and dungeons are represented as expandable systems or locked UI.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with combat HUD, touch skill buttons, navigation panels, and offline-reward modal.
- Created `styles.css` with responsive dark-fantasy mobile UI.
- Created `game.js` with procedural dungeon/hunter/enemy models, third-person camera, autonomous combat, skills, enemy waves/boss, XP/gold, item drops/equipment/upgrades, attributes, rank/class progression, dungeon UI, local saves, and capped offline rewards.
- `node --check game.js` completed without syntax errors.

### Active
- Browser verification and fixing any runtime/visual/gameplay issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move

## Objective
- Build and verify a playable dark-fantasy idle RPG prototype, “RANK UP: THE AWAKENING,” for mobile devices.

- Third-person 3D dungeon combat with autonomous movement, targeting, attacks, enemy attacks, health bars, death, and respawn.

- Forgotten Catacombs with Skeleton Warrior, Goblin, Dark Creature, and Skeleton King.

- Expandable class/rank/dungeon systems; no open world, multiplayer, or manual joystick.
- Build a playable first version without asking clarifying questions.

## Objective
- Upgrade **RANK UP: THE AWAKENING** with a premium dark-fantasy presentation and complete shop UI while preserving gameplay.
- Prepare the browser prototype for future Google Play Billing without simulating payments or granting paid products client-side.

## Requirements
- Preserve combat, dungeon, progression, offline rewards, and existing systems.
- Support gold and premium crystals, shop categories, product details, ownership/equipping, purchase confirmation, and purchase history.
- Real-money transactions require native Google Play Billing, trusted receipt verification, duplicate prevention, eligible restoration, and account persistence; never store card data or simulate successful payments.
- Improve characters, environments, animations, effects, and boss introductions for Android-friendly presentation.

## Decisions
- The game remains a browser prototype; real-money purchases require a native Android billing bridge and trusted backend.
- The web client must not grant paid products.

## Work State
### Completed

- Perform final syntax and diff checks.

### Blocked
- Actual Google Play transaction processing, trusted receipt verification, restoration, and account-level persistence require native Android billing integration and a trusted backend, neither present in this browser prototype.

1. Continue visual and gameplay review; fix any integration issues found.
2. Run final syntax, mobile, and diff checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Gameplay, shop/billing integration, and 3D visuals.
- `index.html`: HUD, shop entry points, navigation, and boss-introduction markup.
- `styles.css`: Responsive shop, HUD, and boss-introduction styling.
